Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As promised, I pulled together a concise pricing slate for the visibility add-ons you asked about: retention, tracing, and our advanced dashboard pack. High level summary below; see the attached spreadsheet for line-item math.

Summary (recommended starting bundle)
- Retention: 90-day default (cheap incremental across token-days). 365-day archive option available as an add-on.
- Tracing: Standard sampling (1%) included; higher-fidelity plans at 5% and 10% available as priced tiers.
- Advanced Dashboards: One-time setup + monthly seats; optional pro visual pack with alerting and synthetic checks.

Pricing anchors (illustrative)
- 90-day retention: $0.012 / token-day
- 365-day retention: $0.009 / token-day (volume tiered)
- Tracing +5%: +$2,400/mo for sample-heavy workloads
- Dashboard Pro: $1,500 one-time + $250/mo per seat

We're open to packaging these into a single add-on SKU with commit discounts. For AtlasPay's scale (estimated 200M tokens/month), the most leverage comes from committing to a 12-month bundle (we can apply a stepped discount).

Attachments: redwood-observability-pricing-2026.xlsx (pricing workbook), AtlasPay_RFP.pdf (your RFP for reference)

Next steps: could we schedule a short call Wednesday to walk the numbers and identify the retention sweet spot for your team? If you prefer, I can send a written quote and a 12-month commitment option for procurement.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Liam Torres <liam.torres@atlaspay.com>

Irene —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. A few clarifying questions from procurement and engineering:

1) Retention: we like 90 days as a baseline but need an explicit cost delta to go to 365 for long-term trend analysis. Can you model 90 vs 365 at our estimated volume (200M tokens/mo)?
2) Tracing: what does the +5% tier translate to in retained trace volume and dashboard cost? We also want confirmation that trace samples are exported to our S3 (same retention rules).
3) Dashboards: procurement asked whether the one-time setup can be credited against the first quarter if we sign a 12-month commitment.
4) Discount ask: AtlasPay is an early-stage fintech scaling fast — any flexibility on a commercial concession (recommended: 18% ARR discount) to accelerate commitment?

Procurement window is ~2 weeks. If you can get a revised quote with a 12-month committed path and an onboarding credit, we can move to legal.

-Liam
Head of Platform, AtlasPay

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Irene —

Suggested counterproposal below. We kept it simple to make procurement's life easy and protected unit economics.

Counterproposal (12-month committed path)
- Bundle: Visibility Core + Tracing Standard + Dashboard Pro (3 seats)
- Pricing: 90-day retention at $0.011 / token-day; 365-day as an add-on at $0.0075 / token-day (volume tiers applied at >250M tokens/mo)
- Tracing: Standard (1%) included; 5% sampling available for +$1,800/mo; 10% at +$3,400/mo. Export to customer S3 is supported; exported artifacts follow chosen retention bucket (we will not charge double for export storage beyond transfer costs).
- Dashboard onboarding: $1,500 one-time, we can offer a $1,500 credit (effectively $0) if AtlasPay signs a 12-month commit within two weeks.
- Commercial concession: offer 15% off list on the add-on bundle for a 12-month commit. We cannot meet 18% by policy without AE manager sign-off, but 15% plus the onboarding credit should be close to their ask.
- Additional: offer a one-time $5k professional services credit for ingestion tuning if they sign within the procurement window.

Rationale: preserves margin while giving procurement clear incentives (onboarding credit + PS credit + 15% off). If they push for 18%, we can escalate for a one-time deal desk review (requires finance approval).

If you want, I can assemble a one-page proposal (numbers sheet + T&Cs) and Irene can send to Liam.

— Monica & Karthik
